_README: Characterization contract for the JS phase machine (web/js/pool_state.js), the source of truth being ported to workflow/phases.py per ADR-0014. Inputs + hand-authored `expected` outputs are the LOCKED contract. tests/tools/gen_phase_oracle.mjs runs these inputs through the REAL pool_state.js and (a) asserts real-JS output equals `expected` here — catching any human misreading of the JS — and (b) emits workflow_phase_oracle.json. The Python port must reproduce this table byte-for-byte. Shapes verified 2026-08-13 against bmdx_pipe file_integrator._build_coverage_matrix (cell = {xlsx: fid|null, txt_csv: [fids], bm2: fid|null}; compound key 'Platform|data_type' or bare 'gene_expression').

_EVOLVING_THIS_CONTRACT.what_it_locks: This pins CURRENT OBSERVABLE BEHAVIOR at sampled input points — outputs, not the port's internals (a dict or a dataclass both pass) and not the set of cases. It is a sampling, not a specification: behavior no case exercises can change silently, so the risk is UNDER-coverage, never over-rigidity. When you find an untested corner, that is a case to ADD (procedure 1), not a flaw in what is locked.
_EVOLVING_THIS_CONTRACT.1_add_coverage: A case you didn't think of. Append it to the relevant array (derive_phase / section_completeness / node_complete), then regenerate: `node tests/tools/gen_phase_oracle.mjs` (or, post-cutover, the Python successor). You are widening the net, not moving it. No tension. Encouraged.
_EVOLVING_THIS_CONTRACT.2_change_a_requirement: A rule genuinely changed (new phase, new platform, e.g. gene_expression now needs xlsx). Change it AT THE SOURCE first, as its own deliberate commit: edit web/js/pool_state.js (pre-cutover) or workflow/phases.py (post-cutover), THEN regenerate the oracle from that source. The `expected` values here update to match the new reality. The contract does not resist this — it just forces 'I am changing behavior' to be an explicit, reviewable act rather than a side effect buried in the port.
_EVOLVING_THIS_CONTRACT.3_forbidden: Do NOT edit an `expected` value (or hand-edit the generated oracle) to make a red port turn green. That is 'I changed behavior while pretending to preserve it' — the one thing this test exists to fight. The always-on oracle-sync guard (test_oracle_matches_case_table) makes it tamper-EVIDENT: the oracle is GENERATED from the source, so a faked value shows up as a suspicious hand-edit to a generated file. If a port case is red, the port is wrong (procedure 2 if the requirement really changed), not the table.
_EVOLVING_THIS_CONTRACT.source_of_truth_inverts_at_cutover: While pool_state.js still holds the phase logic, the oracle is generated FROM the JS (correct for the port window). Once ADR-0014 migration step 5 deletes derivePoolPhase/the completeness fns from pool_state.js, the Node generator can no longer read them — Python becomes the source of truth, and gen_phase_oracle.mjs must be replaced by a gen_phase_oracle.py that regenerates the same oracle from the port. Tracked as an ADR-0014 follow-up.

derive_phase.name: no_files_is_empty
derive_phase.why: Branch 1: !hasFiles wins. All downstream flags set to prove the gate short-circuits.

derive_phase.name: files_no_validation_is_uploaded
derive_phase.why: Branch 3: files exist, no validation report yet.

derive_phase.name: stale_regresses_to_uploaded_over_everything
derive_phase.why: EDGE (accreted): hasStale beats a fully-approved artifact set. Pool mutated after approval must force re-validate. Branch 2 precedes integrated/approved branches.

derive_phase.name: stale_beats_validation_errors
derive_phase.why: EDGE: stale precedence over VALIDATION_ERRORS branch too.

derive_phase.name: validated_clean_not_integrated
derive_phase.why: Branch 5: validation report present, no errors, not yet integrated.

derive_phase.name: integrated_not_approved
derive_phase.why: Branch 6: integrated exists, no animal report (not approved).

derive_phase.name: independent_flags_integrated_true_animal_false
derive_phase.why: CONTRACT NOTE: derivePoolPhase treats hasIntegrated and hasAnimalReport as INDEPENDENT, even though the web caller (chemical.js) currently conflates both to !!data.animal_report. The port will feed them SEPARATELY (integrated.json exists vs animal_report.json exists) — more correct — so the pure function must honor the independent contract. This case pins it.

derive_phase.name: validation_report_present_errors_flag_false_takes_precedence_over_missing_integrated
derive_phase.why: EDGE: ordering — a present clean report with no integration lands on VALIDATED, not something further along.

section_completeness.name: body_weight_complete
section_completeness.why: Apical platform with both tox-study and bm2 → complete.

section_completeness.name: body_weight_missing_bm2
section_completeness.why: Apical missing bm2 → one missing message.

section_completeness.name: body_weight_missing_tox
section_completeness.why: Apical missing study data → study-data message.

missing: Requires study data (.txt/.csv) for NTP statistics

section_completeness.name: body_weight_missing_both
section_completeness.why: Apical missing both → BOTH messages, in source order (tox first, then bm2).

missing: Requires study data (.txt/.csv) for NTP statistics

section_completeness.name: apical_xlsx_counts_as_toxstudy
section_completeness.why: EDGE: hasToxStudy = xlsx OR txt_csv>0. An apical platform with xlsx-only study data + bm2 is complete.

section_completeness.name: clinical_alias_collapses_and_completes
section_completeness.why: EDGE (accreted): fingerprinter emits short name 'Clinical'; PLATFORM_ALIASES maps it to 'Clinical Observations'. Clinical Observations needs only tox-study (CSV incidence), no bm2 → complete.

section_completeness.name: clinical_observations_missing_csv
section_completeness.why: Clinical Observations with no study data → its own message.

section_completeness.name: tissue_concentration_xlsx_complete
section_completeness.why: Tissue Concentration needs xlsx sidecar only (no bm2 columns).

section_completeness.name: tissue_concentration_txt_only_still_incomplete
section_completeness.why: EDGE: hasToxStudy is TRUE (txt_csv>0) yet the platform is INCOMPLETE because the check is specifically `if (!tiers.xlsx)`. Proves the completeness gate is per-platform-specific, not just hasToxStudy.

section_completeness.name: gene_expression_bare_key_complete
section_completeness.why: Genomics uses the bare 'gene_expression' key (no compound), needs bm2 with gene-expression data.

section_completeness.name: unknown_platform_defaults_complete
section_completeness.why: EDGE: a platform in NO requirement branch (not apical, not tissue/clinical/gene) has no missing list → complete:true with empty missing. Prevents the port from over-restricting.

section_completeness.name: compound_keys_collapse_and_merge_tiers
section_completeness.why: EDGE: two compound keys for the same platform collapse into ONE platform, MERGING tiers (bm2 from one, txt_csv from the other) → complete. Pins the collapse/merge behavior.

section_completeness.name: empty_matrix_yields_empty_map
section_completeness.why: Empty coverage matrix → empty completeness map.

node_complete.name: non_data_node_always_complete
node_complete.why: A node with neither platform nor children (narrative/front matter) is always complete.

node_complete.name: leaf_complete_when_platform_complete
node_complete.why: Leaf table node inherits its platform's completeness.

node_complete.name: leaf_incomplete_propagates_missing
node_complete.why: Leaf node surfaces the platform's missing list verbatim.

node_complete.name: leaf_platform_absent_from_map
node_complete.why: EDGE: leaf whose platform has no completeness entry → its own 'No data for platform' message.

missing: No data for platform: Body Weight

node_complete.name: group_complete_when_all_children_complete
node_complete.why: Group node complete only if ALL child table nodes complete.

node_complete.name: group_incomplete_labels_child_by_platform
node_complete.why: EDGE: a child with no title falls back to child.platform as its label; the group aggregates 'Label: reasons'.

missing: Organ Weight: Requires .bm2 for BMD/BMDL values

node_complete.name: group_child_platform_absent_from_map
node_complete.why: EDGE: group child whose platform is missing from the map → 'No data for <platform>' inside the aggregated label.

missing: Organ Weight: No data for Organ Weight

node_complete.name: group_with_no_table_children_is_complete
node_complete.why: EDGE: a group whose children have no platform (pure prose) has nothing to gate on → complete.

node_complete.name: unknown_node_id_is_complete
node_complete.why: EDGE: a nodeId not present in the tree → treated as a non-data node, complete:true.

node_complete.name: empty_completeness_map_blocks_everything
node_complete.why: EDGE: an empty completeness map short-circuits to the 'validate the pool first' message, regardless of node.

missing: No completeness data — validate the pool first
